fixtures.preview: United head to Anfield for the biggest rivalry in English football on Sunday 22 Nov, 4:30pm UK (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney).
talking_points: Kick-off is confirmed at 4:30pm UK time after Liverpool's November fixture changes.
United came into November with just one Premier League win, though they beat Roma 3-2 in the Champions League (pre-Villa reports).
Injury and suspension lists were long before the Villa game (Martinez suspended, Baleba out for weeks); anything beyond that is unconfirmed until team news.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
Brentford visit on Saturday 28 Nov at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), United's first 3pm Saturday kick-off of the season.
Sydney travel to Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney) after beating the Mariners 4-1 on Friday night.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure scored a hat-trick against the Mariners, his second for the club, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first Sydney FC goal.
The win bounced Sydney back after a 2-1 loss at Melbourne City on 31 Oct.
Jacob Farrell and Gus Hoefsloot were in the squad for the Mariners game; Abel Walatee (ankle) and Jake Hollman (hamstring) were out then, so Brisbane availability is unconfirmed.

fixtures.preview: The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm.

notes: Research was patchy: club, venue and supermarket sites were mostly unreadable and many searches returned old seasons. Items described as not re-checked are carried from the last run.

Man Utd v Aston Villa (3:30am Sydney) was removed as finished; I could not find a reliable final score (live pages disagreed). The Liverpool preview uses pre-Villa reporting, and Stan Sport as broadcaster was not re-confirmed.

Sydney FC: Brisbane (21 Nov), Melbourne Victory (6 Dec), Auckland (12 Dec) and Macarthur (28 Dec) come from the club and A-League sites; the A-League guide lists no Sydney games in rounds 6, 7, 9 or 10, so the list may be incomplete. Perth Glory (18 Dec) is carried over.
Big matches: broadcasters were not re-checked and no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas games were found. Sydney FC Women v Canberra United is carried over from the club tickets page.

Arts: Aldous Harding is confirmed via Musick (Ticketek). Foo Fighters, Robbie Williams, Melanie C, Iron Maiden, Beetlejuice and Whispering Jack were not re-checked. Northlane (Enmore, 11 Nov) and Men I Trust (Enmore, 20-21 Nov) appear in listings but were not opened.

Local: school events come from the Term 4 calendar and Week 4 Principal Updates (dates may change). No South Eveleigh events or local news from the last 7 days were found. Adaptive Tennis was not re-checked.
Not found: Sydney matcha pop-ups, Pokemon or Minecraft kids' events, or a Sydney junior parkrun for November.
Groceries: Woolworths, Coles and Aldi items are from catalogue sites for 4-10 Nov with no was-prices shown. The Wed 11 Nov specials were not yet published apart from one Aldi item.
Horizon: not re-checked, except that Rugby World Cup 2027 sales have run since Feb 2026 (ballot and first-come phases); check tickets.rugbyworldcup.com for what is left.
